'''Groj''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Tan-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], dark brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] across their face, Groj wore dark [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Groj was assigned to [[Carrick Station]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] center of operations, where they equipped [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] with gear.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Groj appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a vendor who sold PVP gear for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class. Groj originally sold Battlemaster gear, but with the release of Game Update 2.0 on [[April 9]], the PvP commendation system was simplified, condensing most of the different gear levels into a new system. As a result, Groj was reclassified, and their gear and that of similar vendors often changes with new tiers of gear.<ref name="TOR" /> Groj was later removed entirely in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
